name: homie
description: Homie for studios: make games, music and video with Claude Code or Codex, run your studio's site and public multiplayer rooms on your own Cloudflare (free plan), and list your games, songs and videos in the homie.rocks directory. Beta.

plugins.name: homie
plugins.description: Set up a studio (a setup status of your accounts and tools, then a checklist that never jumps ahead), plan each game into its Game Codex (a page in the game's own look, with the build's progress), build with one agent or several in parallel, make or remix multiplayer games or make an existing single-player game multiplayer (netplay public rooms, bots, rounds), give games sound effects and synthesized music made locally for free, songs and game scores (ElevenLabs, on your own account), covers and painted art and trailers and music videos (gameplay capture, or fal on your own account, under a budget), playtest games with measured checks and a blind review, preview locally, deploy the studio's site to its own Cloudflare on the free plan (no payment method; rooms of up to 32) with an epic landing page for every game and the studio's news posts, list it in the homie.rocks directory, read the studio's own stats (visits, plays, rounds, where people came from), and run its live games from a back office (who is playing now, announcements, kick and mute, private / invite-only beta / public launch states, a remix switch; the owner confirms what takes something away with one tap). Beta.
